summary: The LLM landscape in late 2026 is dominated by a handful of major vendors — OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic lead on both consumer traffic and developer adoption, while open-weight models from Meta, DeepSeek, Alibaba (Qwen), and Mistral drive HuggingFace downloads and self-hosted deployments. Enterprise consumption increasingly flows through cloud aggregators (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, IBM watsonx), which substantially amplifies the real-world reach of models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, and Mistral beyond their direct-API numbers. ChatGPT still commands the largest share of generative-AI web traffic (~55.5% in August 2026), but its lead has narrowed as Gemini and Claude gain ground.

models.name: GPT-5.1
models.popularity_notes: OpenAI's flagship line powers ChatGPT, which captured ~55.5% of global generative-AI web traffic in August 2026, and is widely available via the OpenAI API and Azure OpenAI aggregator for enterprise consumption.
strengths: Broad enterprise availability via Azure OpenAI
models.best_for: General-purpose applications, coding assistants, and enterprise chat deployments

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Gemini ranked second in generative-AI traffic (~26.9% chatbot market share, ~1.14 billion visits) and benefits from deep integration with Google Vertex AI and Google Workspace for enterprise reach.
strengths: Native Vertex AI and Google Cloud integration
models.best_for: Multimodal and long-context applications within the Google ecosystem

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.popularity_notes: Rated the highest-intelligence model on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard and Claude's web traffic (~968 million visits) ranks third; it is available across AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and direct API, giving it strong enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: Complex reasoning, high-stakes coding, and enterprise agentic workflows

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.popularity_notes: The cost-efficient Claude tier is among the highest-intelligence models per the Artificial Analysis leaderboard and is a default workhorse for developers, widely distributed via AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex.
models.best_for: Production coding assistants and high-volume agentic applications

models.name: GPT-5.1 mini
models.popularity_notes: The low-cost OpenAI tier sees extremely high API call volume for high-throughput and cost-sensitive workloads, and is available through both the OpenAI API and Azure OpenAI.
models.best_for: High-volume, latency-sensitive, and cost-constrained production tasks

models.name: Llama 4
models.popularity_notes: Meta's open-weight Llama family leads HuggingFace downloads and self-hosted deployments, and is offered across AWS Bedrock, Azure, Google Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx, giving it broad enterprise and developer reach.
strengths: Open weights for self-hosting and fine-tuning
Available across all major cloud aggregators
models.best_for: Self-hosted deployments, fine-tuning, and privacy-sensitive enterprise applications

models.name: DeepSeek-V3.2
models.popularity_notes: DeepSeek is the highest-ranked Chinese AI tool (~319 million visits) and its open-weight, low-cost models drive strong HuggingFace download volume and developer adoption worldwide.
models.best_for: Cost-efficient reasoning and coding at scale

models.name: Qwen3
models.popularity_notes: Alibaba's Qwen family is a top performer on HuggingFace downloads and a leading open-weight model family, especially popular in Asia and among developers building fine-tuned derivatives.
strengths: Open weights with large derivative ecosystem
models.best_for: Multilingual applications and customizable open-weight deployments

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.popularity_notes: Google's fast, low-cost Gemini tier drives high API volume for high-throughput applications and is natively available through Google Vertex AI for enterprise consumption.
models.best_for: High-volume, latency-sensitive multimodal tasks in the Google ecosystem

models.name: Mistral Large 3
models.popularity_notes: Mistral's models are popular in Europe and among open-weight adopters, and are distributed through Azure, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and IBM watsonx, giving them meaningful enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: European enterprise deployments and open-weight production applications
